description: Connect an AI assistant to Hyperliquid for market discovery, account reads, trading, and collateral management.
example_prompts: Find Anthropic and OpenAI markets and show their collateral and leverage limits.
List markets categorized as pre-IPO across all deployments.
Show my available, held, and total balances and my current account mode.
Show my positions and open orders on the xyz deployment.
Check my current trading capacity for a specific market.
anything_else: Supports default perpetuals, builder perpetuals and spot. Financial actions can use real funds. Availability and execution are subject to Hyperliquid rules and account permissions.

authentication.credential: EVM private key or 12/24-word English BIP-39 seed phrase
authentication.configuration: Configure Authorization: Bearer <credential> in the client secure credential settings; never put credentials in prompts or URLs. With a phrase, call hyperliquid_list_wallet_accounts, ask the user to choose, and pass the returned index/address as walletAccount on every other authenticated tool. No account is selected automatically. English BIP-39 without an extra passphrase; private-key credentials require no selection.
authentication.note: Other tools require a valid private key or seed phrase. Invalid supplied credentials are rejected even on public operations.

technical_specs.discovery: Use tools/list for current tools and input schemas; call hyperliquid_get_docs for current usage guidance.
